# LASSO analysis

```{r}
library(glmnet)
library(dplyr)

# Match the directory structure used by the preceding speech-marker and Boruta analyses.
results_dir <- Sys.getenv("FHS_RESULTS_DIR", unset = "Results")
data_dir <- Sys.getenv("FHS_OUTPUT_DIR", unset = file.path(results_dir, "Data"))
feature_variant <- tolower(Sys.getenv("FHS_FEATURE_VARIANT", unset = "normal"))
if (!(feature_variant %in% c("normal", "filtered"))) {
  stop("FHS_FEATURE_VARIANT must be 'normal' or 'filtered'.")
}

table_dir <- file.path(results_dir, if (feature_variant == "filtered") {
  "Table_Results_filtered"
} else {
  "Table_Results"
})
dir.create(table_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

input_rds_filename <- if (feature_variant == "filtered") {
  "tauFeatureAmyloidDemo_filtered.rds"
} else {
  "tauFeatureAmyloidDemo.rds"
}

# Filtered RDS adds two linguistic-feature columns before the target/metadata fields.
feature_end_col <- if (feature_variant == "filtered") 67 else 65
```

```{r}
# The RDS is generated by the corresponding normal/filtered speech-marker analysis.
whole_df<-readRDS(file.path(data_dir, input_rds_filename))
if (ncol(whole_df) < feature_end_col) {
  stop("Input RDS does not contain the expected feature columns.")
}
```


```{r}
# Preserve the original column-based predictor selection for each feature variant.
whole_df_amyloid_selected<-whole_df[,c(7:feature_end_col)]
whole_df_amyloid_selected<-na.omit(whole_df_amyloid_selected)
# Keep complete cases for the tau models, as in the original analysis.
whole_df_tau_selected<-whole_df
whole_df_tau_selected<-na.omit(whole_df_tau_selected)
```

```{r}
# Previously selected feature–tau associations from the speech-marker regression.
lm_results<-read.csv(file.path(table_dir, "lm_featureDemoAmyloidTauLmd_select.csv"))
```


```{r}
lm_results$Linguistic_Feature<-lm_results$Outcome
```

```{r}
all_features <- unique(unlist(lm_results$Linguistic_Feature)) 
# all_features<-all_features[all_features%in%c('')]
result_df <- data.frame(Feature = all_features)
colnames(result_df) <- c("Feature") 
```
## Tau LASSO using regression-selected features

```{r}
# Run a separate Gaussian LASSO for every tau PET region in the regression table.
# alpha=1 applies L1 regularization; the penalty is chosen by 10-fold cross-validation.
for (k in unique(lm_results$Feature)) {
  
  print(paste("Running LASSO for tau region:", k))
  lm_results_sub <- lm_results %>% filter(Feature == k)
  feature_list_sub <- unique(lm_results_sub$Linguistic_Feature)

  y <- whole_df_tau_selected[[k]]   
  
  df_sub <- whole_df_tau_selected[, c(feature_list_sub, 
                                      'age', 'sex', 'ADNI.petpos', 
                                      'Educg', 'LMd')]
  
  # Standardize numerical predictors before constructing the model matrix.
  numeric_vars <- c(feature_list_sub, "age", "LMd")
  
  df_sub[, numeric_vars] <- scale(df_sub[, numeric_vars])
    
  x <- model.matrix(~., df_sub)
  
  covariates <- c("age", "sex", "ADNI.petpos", "Educg", "LMd")
  
  set.seed(123)
  cv_lasso <- cv.glmnet(
    x, y,
    alpha = 1,
    family = "gaussian",
    nfolds = 10
  )
  
  best_lambda <- cv_lasso$lambda.min
  
  final_lasso <- glmnet(
    x, y, 
    alpha = 1,
    lambda = best_lambda
  )
  
  coef_df <- coef(final_lasso)
  coef_df <- as.data.frame(as.matrix(coef_df))
  print(coef_df)
  coef_df <- data.frame(
    Feature = rownames(coef_df),
    Coefficient = coef_df$`s0`,
    row.names = NULL
  )
  
  # Retain the original export convention: a zero coefficient is encoded as -1.
  coef_df$Coefficient[coef_df$Coefficient == 0] <- -1
  result_df <- merge(result_df, coef_df, by = "Feature", all.x = TRUE)
  colnames(result_df)[ncol(result_df)] <- k
}

# Fill absent feature–region combinations with 0 in the wide output table.
result_df[is.na(result_df)] <- 0

```


```{r}
write.csv(result_df,file.path(table_dir, "lasso_lm_tau.csv"))
```
